_note: brand-decomposer's checked-in routing corpus. This is a LEXICAL-OVERLAP legibility aid, NOT a verdict — routing-eval.py measures token overlap between a phrase and the description only. Positives span the invocation families (imperative 'grade/decompose this brand book', diagnostic 'is this brand spec usable / an operating system', symptom 'generic idea / palette without roles / unsourced rules / voice is only adjectives', object-first 'this brand guidelines document', the CRITIQUE family 'does this work align to the brand system', plus 2-3 indirect paraphrases). The indirect positives ('beautiful but no one can use it') are deliberately low-overlap and MAY score recall 0 here — a proxy limit, not a description defect. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from the most CONFUSABLE neighbours: the brand-forge MAKERS/JUDGES (brand-muse, brand-copywriter, brand-council, brand-evaluate — this skill grades the SPEC and aligns work to it; it neither makes the brand nor passes expert-taste judgment), and the design-skills siblings it fences against (layout-decomposer, color-verifier, color-science, typography-lettering), plus near-miss decomposers. Each negative belongs to a NAMED peer. Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
